Dan Kitwood / Getty Images

After eight years, more than 200 million predictions and a Nobel Prize for two of its creators, the team behind AlphaFold—Google DeepMind’s artificial intelligence program to predict protein structure—has itself folded. On Wednesday Google announced that Hassabis would step down as DeepMind’s CEO to become chief scientist of Alphabet, Google’s parent company.
